claim: A crashed run leaves a lock that only an explicit, challenge-authenticated operator attestation can clear — the system never infers liveness on its own.

steps.label: a second run tries to take a lock that is already held
steps.note: The first holder may have crashed. The lock manager has no way to know that, and does not guess.

steps.label: clearing the lock with the wrong challenge
steps.note: No timeout, no heartbeat, no 'probably dead by now'. Inferring liveness is how two runs end up writing at once.

steps.label: an operator attests the exact challenge
the next run can now acquire it
steps.evidence: a fresh challenge is issued for this holder
